title: Heads-up
description: A short text in the centre of the mirror for a few seconds: someone at the door, the laundry is done.
help: It can come from your home automation, a web call, another module, a schedule or a watched web address.

duration.title: Time shown
duration.description: How long a text stays on the mirror before it fades away. A text that arrives meanwhile waits its turn.

size.title: Text size
size.description: Long texts are set a little smaller so they fit.

keep_hours.title: Keep a waiting heads-up for
keep_hours.description: How long a waiting text is kept before it is dropped.
keep_hours.help: A text waits its turn while another shows or while the mirror's screen is off. One that has waited longer than this is dropped instead of shown.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Password for sending heads-ups. Empty: anyone on your home network can send one.
token.help: Empty: anyone on your home network can send a heads-up to http://mirrordash.local/api/modules/<name>/show (the name is shown on this module's card in the admin). With a token set, every call must carry it, in an X-Token header or a token address parameter.

senders.title: Modules that may send
senders.description: Other modules whose heads-ups are shown, by package name.
senders.help: Add each one's package name, for example mirrordash_now_playing_spotify; that module must be installed and set to send. It sends the event <package name>.heads_up.

package.title: Package name
package.pattern_message: A Python package name: letters, digits and underscores, such as mirrordash_now_playing_spotify

timed.title: Texts at set times
timed.description: A text shown once at a time of day, in the mirror's time zone. A text due while the screen is off waits for it, within the hours above.

days.title: Days
days.description: Leave all unticked for every day.

watch_url.title: Address to watch
watch_url.description: A web address that gives a text, shown when it changes.
watch_url.help: The address can be at home or on the internet. The text is shown when it changes; the first one after a start is not. Empty: not used.

watch_seconds.title: Time between checks
watch_seconds.description: How often the address is asked.

watch_field.title: Field in a JSON answer
watch_field.description: If the answer is JSON, the path to the text in it, such as state.message. Empty: the answer itself is the text.
